display.purpose: Google Fonts Syne 800 (monumental, architectural headings inspired by HOZON and TŌPAS) and Space Grotesk 700 (Swiss neo-grotesque section titles).

editorial.purpose: Instrument Serif Italic 400 for delicate high-contrast editorial accents ('mais o sabor ganha foco').

body.purpose: Instrument Sans 400/500/600 for razor-sharp, modern readability and descriptions.

mono.purpose: Space Mono 400/700 for HUD telemetry, timeline readouts, coordinates and metadata tags.

motion.name: video-scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Continuous native video playback proportional to scroll velocity, scrubbing from 0.0s to 7.0s until the ice breaks and melts into pure creaminess without keyframe stutter.

motion.name: camera-dolly-zoom
motion.purpose: Cinematic camera dolly effect expanding the central photo in the viewport while neighboring cards scale down and take soft bokeh blur.

motion.name: 3d-axial-tilt
motion.purpose: Multi-axis scene movement giving kinetic cards realistic physical depth as the user navigates the mosaic.

motion.name: garnish-parallax
motion.purpose: Floating fresh ingredients (strawberry, dark chocolate, ice crystals, mint) floating around the cards with depth-based translation and rotation.

motion.name: atmospheric-shift
motion.purpose: Ambient background transitioning from glacial deep dark (#101114) to rich berry wine (#1C0D14) to velvet dark cocoa (#160D08).

motion.name: cursor
motion.value: flower spin + drag circle + close button
motion.purpose: Custom interactive cursor with difference blend mode and contextual transformations.
